S: Brown the mince with the spices, add the tomatoes and simmer until thick. Grill the franks until blistered and toast the rolls. Fill, spoon over the chilli and top with cheese and onion.

M: Stretch the dough into 2 rounds on oiled trays. Spread with passata, sprinkle with oregano and top with mozzarella, pepperoni and capsicum. Bake at 250C until blistered, then cut each into 8 long petal slices from the centre out.

Cook the onions slowly in the butter until soft and sweet. Season and sear the steak 3 minutes a side, rest, then slice thinly. Split and toast the rolls, spread with mustard and pile on steak, onions, cheese and rocket.

Crush the biscuits, mix with the butter and press into a 22cm pie tin. Whisk the condensed milk, yolks, lime zest and 125ml lime juice until thick. Pour into the base and bake at 160C until just set, then chill. Whip the cream and spoon on top with more zest.
K: Put two scoops of ice cream in each of 4 tall glasses. Pour the root beer slowly down the side so it foams up.
